reason: Both frozen native beauty candidates lack a stable, meaningful realism improvement. Independent order-blind AI review agrees.

testedHypotheses.observation: Thin grooves soften but the broad lower-lip area remains smooth/waxy; no sufficient benefit for extra shader complexity.
Weak local response; no reliable realism improvement at the native macro view.

dataFinding.measure: Ownership-weighted resolved sample response after 4x MSAA and 8-bit quantization, not geometric area or perceptual visibility
dataFinding.meaning: Frozen B does not establish broad inter-groove support across the selected smooth lower-lip region. Local normal response is present, so a complete normal-transmission failure is excluded.
dataFinding.independentAudit: Second agent independently checked PNG and raw hashes, actual shader patches, unchanged native state/uniforms, restoration and ROI sums.

supportedCorrection: Future structural proposals must demonstrate that their support reaches the observed defect and passes into final normals before aesthetic comparison. Larger amplitude alone does not supply missing support.
notEstablished: Unique cause of the overall wax appearance
Relative responsibility of missing adjacent roots, common longitudinal envelope, and resolution gates
